title: PRESSER | Bre Henry, Nina Moorer & Shayla Meyer - Postgame vs Georgia (11-20-26)
text: trainer will opening make an opening statement. Following that, we'll open the floor for questions. Please raise your hand and we'll get a microphone to you, coach. >> Yeah. Um well, we were really excited to be here at this tournament. It's always a really great tournament to be a part of and feels like you kind of have a fresh start. Um going into the postseason, um I think that there was some resiliency that I did see that our team has been working on throughout the year. Um, but you know, we didn't perform as well as we would have liked to and I believe that our team can. Um, so we're just going to get back to the drawing board and starting January and I'm excited for seeing what we can do the following year. >> We'll open up for questions if you raise your hand. Go ahead. Right here. >> Um, Shayla, I just want to give you uh a chance to reflect on your career a little bit. um 970 kills, first NCA tournament win in program history a couple years ago. Uh what has this program uh meant to you? >> I think we have a great group of staff that have really bought into us and developed us for 5 years and I think that speaks a lot to what we've done and what we've accomplished. Um, I'm just so proud of Bri and for bringing us here and I think you have so much more to give and I'm just really excited to see what they can do in the future. Just keep bringing girls in that can really commit and develop with them and buy into them. >> Uh, Nia, today uh what what was going well for the offense at least initially? Um, and uh what did you like from your team overall? Um, I think we did a great job of establishing our middleles. Ideally, been working on that all year and that kind of let us open up our pens a little bit and I think ours do a great job of just being an option and working hard and transitioning it up and just working to put the ball away. >> Uh, coach, um, want to give you a chance to reflect on, uh, your two seniors here as well as, uh, Tessa who's back, uh, back in the locker room over there. But what have they meant to this program? uh what they meant to you personally. >> They're a great great group. Um I really enjoy working with them. They serve our team so well. Um and you know Shayla and Tessa being here for their five years is just is really impressive especially in the day and age of the transfer portal and stuff. Um but also the transfer portal is a blessing because it brought us Mina too and um how she's come in and just been so mature and um you know embedded herself in our program. We're so happy to have her as well. So, uh, the seniors are a great group, um, mature group, and, um, you know, I wish this would have been a more complete year, um, for the whole entire group, but I love these guys, and I'm so proud of them, and I can't wait to see what they do in the future. I think they're going to have fantastic careers ahead of them, and they're going to be able to represent Old Miss, um, very well. >> Thank you, buddy.
